violations.text: The hand-washing sink on the Starbucks serving line was blocked by containers. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Containers were moved during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Ice scoop was moved to three bay sink during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the kitchen. Establishment is to obtain thermo labels or similar internal temperature measuring devices. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Ice was observed built up on the Walk in Freezer blower. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Establishment is to remove ice build up. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2024

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Establishment must fix weather stripping. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2024
The handle on the Starbucks low boy was not in good repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/21/2024
